blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has summoned a student vlogger for allegedly driving a motorcycle without a helmet. In the show-cause order (SCO) dated Sept. 26 and made public on Sunday, the LTO directed the student to appear at a hearing on Oct. 2 at the Intelligence and Investigation Division office in East Avenue, Quezon City. The student was also ordered to submit beforehand a sworn statement and explanation as to “why you should not be held administratively liable for Mandatory Use of Motorcycle Helmets and why your driver’s license should not be suspended or revoked for being […]...
